basics.name: Saurabh Rajkamal Upadhyay
basics.label: Flutter Developer & Product Engineer
basics.summary: Mumbai-based Software Engineer specializing in cross-platform mobile development with Flutter and Dart, plus Python for automation, fintech, and APIs. Founder of Snapdrop (a Flutter + Figma plugin product). Published technical writer on Medium with 240+ followers across articles on Flutter performance, app-size reduction, and security. Open to full-time, contract, and freelance opportunities, remote and hybrid.

work.name: Snapdrop (independent)
work.summary: Founded and shipped Snapdrop end-to-end: a Flutter mobile app paired with a Figma plugin that lets designers transfer images from phone to Figma over a QR-code session. Solely responsible for product, architecture, mobile and plugin code, design system, localization, and release.
highlights: Designed and implemented real-time pairing between mobile app and Figma plugin using Socket.IO
Localized the app across 6 languages (English, Hindi, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, Simplified Chinese) with Flutter intl
Integrated full Firebase observability (Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance Monitoring, Remote Config) for production
Built polished UX with glassmorphism, blurhash placeholders, in-app review, app-upgrader prompts, showcase onboarding

projects.name: Snapdrop
projects.description: Flutter mobile app + Figma plugin for designers. Phone-to-Figma image transfer over a secure QR-code session.
highlights: Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance, Remote Config

projects.name: algo-trader
projects.description: Python-based daily algorithmic trading orchestrator for Indian markets (NSE). Computes custom H3-H6 / L3-L6 levels with Narrow-Range-Day and Insider conditions, places GTT orders via Angel One or Zerodha, and sends Telegram alerts. Runs entirely on free GitHub Actions infrastructure.
highlights: Zero server cost: GitHub Actions runs the trading orchestrator at 9:15 AM IST every trading day
Pluggable broker layer supports both Angel One SmartAPI and Zerodha Kite Connect
Google Sheets used as a lightweight database for stock basket, levels, signals, monthly and yearly rollups
Instant Telegram bot alerts on every signal

projects.name: AxisCore
projects.description: Flutter MVP app shell for a 90-day training product. Feature-first architecture, Riverpod state, GoRouter navigation, local-first persistence, deterministic engines, widget tests.
highlights: Feature-first Flutter architecture with clean repository and data-source boundaries
Riverpod for state, GoRouter for navigation, SharedPreferences for local persistence
Deterministic engines for assessment, protocol, progress, and panic/reset
Widget tests covering the first user loop
